verdict.rationale: Fivetran explicitly documents that transformations (including dbt via hosted dbt Core, dbt Cloud, or Coalesce orchestration) are 'automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule,' directly satisfying the event-driven, post-sync trigger requirement rather than a blind timer [fivetran-docs-37][fivetran-docs-5][fivetran-docs-4][fivetran-docs-25]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that dbt-specific jobs (not just Fivetran's own transformation engine) reliably fire on sync-completion in production, and more detail on how this interacts with dbt Cloud/Coalesce's own scheduling.
